title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR DONE. BACK OPEN. HIPS HONEST. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. THIS IS YOUR POSTERIOR STRENGTH. CONTROL BEATS BOUNCING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. THIS IS YOUR HIP STRENGTH. DO NOT THRUST LIKE YOU ARE AUDITIONING FOR A BLOODY MUSIC VIDEO.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP FORWARD. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. PUSH OFF AND SWITCH. SHORT PATH IF SPACE IS TIGHT. CONTROL THE LANDING.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP FORWARD. CHEST UP. SWITCH CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR POSTERIOR AND LEG WORK. DO NOT STAGGER ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY NEWBORN GIRAFFE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. RETURN WITH CONTROL. CORE STAYS QUIET AND BRACED. NO FLOPPING.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW AND CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR CORE CONTROL. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BEACHED BLOODY FISH.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BELLY QUIET.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. BUILD TOWARD LONGER LATER.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. HIPS UP. SHORT HOLDS. WE BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
